name: API Security
purpose: Enforce rate limiting, parameter validation, schema compliance, and authorization on API endpoints.
inputs: OpenAPI 3.1 contract, endpoint inventory, and data classification
Identity, authorization, tenancy, rate-limit, idempotency, and quota policies
Representative requests, abuse cases, and security acceptance thresholds
outputs: Endpoint security findings mapped to OWASP API risks and contract locations
Validated authorization, schema, rate-limit, and serialization controls
Contract, fuzz, BOLA, and resource-bound test evidence
stop_conditions: No unresolved critical or high authorization, injection, or excessive-data finding remains
Every protected object endpoint enforces tenant and resource authorization
Token budget exhausted or required identity and tenancy authority is missing
